model.name: devstral-small-2-24b
model.about: Mistral AI Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct (2512), a coding model, published only in FP8. Apache-2.0, EU vendor. DOES NOT RUN ON THE A100 with vLLM 0.29 (2026-09-27): with the defaults, torch.compile's inductor fails ('auto_functionalized was not removed', as Ministral 3's FP8 did on an A40); with --enforce-eager, the FP8 matrix kernel for the A100's generation fails (cutlass_scaled_mm_sm80). There is no BF16 release to fall back on. It may run on an Ada, Hopper or Blackwell card, which have FP8 in hardware; those come after the A100s in the list. Settings every Mistral 3 model needed: vLLM v0.29.0, Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none.

failed_start.reason: vLLM failed to start: torch._inductor.exc.InductorError: AssertionError: auto_functionalized was not removed (default settings, 05:32 UTC); with --enforce-eager, RuntimeError: cutlass_scaled_mm_sm80_epilogue (05:46 UTC)

note: Does not run on the A100: vLLM 0.29 cannot serve its FP8 weights there. With the default settings the torch.compile inductor fails; with --enforce-eager the FP8 matrix kernel for the A100 generation (sm80) fails. Mistral publishes it only in FP8. Two attempts, $0.19 together. Recorded afterwards from the daemon run record and .cache/failed-start.log.
